    Extracting graph components from string-map factorizations #

    A nonzero coefficient of a composite selects an intermediate position where both factor coefficients are nonzero. The two coefficient components through that position have product coefficient exactly one: partial-bijection uniqueness leaves no second intermediate position and hence no characteristic-dependent cancellation. Full input or output support of a selected output component then transfers to the corresponding factor component.
